subject: Oakridge Health - access integration staging plan & service-account sequencing

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oakridge Health - access integration staging plan & service-account sequencing

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the kickoff note. A few quick items from our security team before we get to a formal cutover schedule:

- We need a list of recommended service-account names and minimum IAM scopes so we can reconcile with our IAM hygiene policy.
- For IP allowlists: is there a way to stage a narrow range (eg: a NAT pool) during validation, then expand to the production CIDR after go-live?
- SCIM: we run an Azure AD instance. Can you confirm attribute mapping for employeeType/title and group membership?

I copied our security alias (security@oakridgehealth.com) so they can weigh-in; will also schedule a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Annette
Director, IT Security
Oakridge Health
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Annette Cole <annette.cole@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge Health - access integration staging plan & service-account sequencing

Annette — thanks for the clear list. Below are quick answers and next actions; I'll follow up tomorrow with the service-account CSV and an IP staging pattern.

1) Service-account names & scopes
- We recommend a pair of accounts for initial rollout: redwood-ssm-sync (SCIM sync, read/write groups/users) and redwood-ingest (API calls for model inference, token-limited role).
- Minimum scopes: groups.read, users.read, groups.write (for SCIM group sync); inference.invoke (scoped to route).
- I'll attach a template with columns (name, purpose, principal_owner, iam_scope_suggestion).

2) IP allowlist staging
- Yes: we can stage using a narrow NAT pool during validation. Our staging policy supports an allowlist TTL approach: add staging CIDR for 72 hours, validate, then swap to production CIDR. We will provide a rollback plan should connectivity fail.

3) SCIM / Azure AD mapping
- Standard attribute mapping is supported: userName -> userPrincipalName, displayName -> displayName, title -> title, employeeType -> employeeType, groups -> groupMembership.
- We will send a sample mapping JSON and an example SCIM test user you can create in a test tenant.

Next steps (proposed):
- Monday: share service-account template + IP allowlist template (attached).
- Tuesday: 30-min technical call (security + infra) to confirm attribute mapping and NAT plan.
- Week of Nov 15: schedule staged cutover window (2-hour validation).

If that works I'll send calendar invites.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Technical Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: oakridge-ip-allowlist-template.txt (text)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Annette, Sofia — attaching the service-account template and a short checklist for the SCIM validation run. A few implementation notes to call out:

- SCIM delta window: Redwood will honor incremental delta pulls; recommend test group with <50 users for initial validation.
- Service-account rotation: suggest 90-day key rotation cadence for the redwood-ssm-sync account; we can provide automation templates if Oakridge wants to plug into existing rotation pipelines.
- IP health checks: during staging we'll run synthetic calls from our staging nodes — we need one test endpoint on your side to confirm reachability.

Attachment: oakridge_service-account-template.csv (csv)
Attachment: scim-validation-checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

On the call: Jordan will cover NAT sequencing and rollback; I will walk through the SCIM mapping example. Proposed time: Tue Nov 9, 10:00-10:30 PT. Sofia — can you send the invite?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Annette Cole <annette.cole@oakridgehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge Health - access integration staging plan & service-account sequencing

Annette — calendar invite sent for Tue Nov 9 10:00 PT (I included the security alias). Quick operational note in advance:

- Rollback guardrail: if any validation step fails (SCIM group sync mismatch, or IP reachability > 30% failure), we will immediately revert to pre-staging allowlist and suspend SCIM writes. That will keep production stable while we triage.
- Logging: we'll enable request-level audit logging to your shared S3 bucket during the validation window; please confirm write ACL (we can provide presigned URLs if preferred).

Look forward to the call.

—Jordan
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
